ledger.x: 181: Pharnaces I takes land in Paphlagonia.

wars.name: Pharnaces I's war with Pergamon and Cappadocia
wars.outcome: All Pontic conquests in Galatia and Paphlagonia were given back in 179, Sinope excepted.

wars.name: Pontic and Bithynian partition of Paphlagonia
wars.outcome: Mithridates VI and Nicomedes III divided the country; the Senate later ordered Nicomedes out of Paphlagonia (the Kingdom of Pontus page places it after the rising of 97).

certainty.note: The page names the Parthenius and the Halys as Strabo's borders; no treaty or survey line is given for any date.
